title: Deeper/broader peer consumer boundaries and implementation readiness
mode: Primary-source web research and plan refinement; research only
scope: Cross-check open-source DWG/DXF implementation routes and downstream consumer limitations.
Refine boundaries between projected geometry, raw modeler carriers, and independent solid semantics.
Make existing MATERIAL and TABLESTYLE subplans more implementation-ready without expanding full-suite cadence.

sources.revision: Mutable NEWS page and 0.14 release page accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: NEWS reports targeted HATCH path-state, MATERIAL color/mapper, TABLESTYLE row true-color, and final SAT-block fixes, as well as continuing parser-hardening work. The 0.14 release notes identify AC1018 as the supported DWG writer target, later versions as experimental, and AC1021 encoding as a fallback to AC1024.
sources.limits: Release notes and mutable source are peer-maintained route evidence, not a local defect reproduction, normative format authority, or independent correctness oracle.

sources.revision: Mutable master/release/issue pages accessed 2026-10-22; issue #1195 reports package 3.4.9
sources.observed: The project publishes independent DXF/DWG reader/writer version claims. Issue #1195 reports 3DSOLID/REGION omission on the named 3.4.9 DWG-to-DXF route.
sources.limits: The report is version-specific and does not establish behavior in v3.8.0 or a local libdxfrw defect. No package or source build was run.

sources.observed: The ACIS API supports limited known structures and polyhedral-body generation/extraction; SAT export is documented for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013/R2018. The documentation explicitly excludes arbitrary ACIS editing and states that ezdxf has no ACIS kernel.
sources.limits: A bounded carrier generator or planar-polyhedron observer is not a general ACIS/B-rep semantic oracle; no package or geometry was run.

sources.revision: Mutable stable documentation accessed 2026-10-22; DXF binary read documented since GDAL 3.12
sources.observed: The DXF reader projects selected records into OGR geometry, tessellates some curves, can inline/merge blocks, and skips ACIS-bearing entities by default. DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASMData plus a 12-value transform for AC1027+ but does not create solid geometries. The separate CAD/DWG driver is read-only and documents a small primitive subset.
sources.limits: OGR projections and optional raw carrier values do not constitute a full object graph, DWG writer, or ACIS semantic result.

sources.revision: Mutable main-branch source and documentation accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: FreeCAD's DWG path invokes a selected external converter and then its DXF importer. Current DXF documentation says ACIS solid blobs cannot be read by the standard importer; the DWG page states converter output inherits DXF-importer limitations.
sources.limits: Documentation defines a route boundary but does not substitute for native Linux/Windows tests. No FreeCAD application or converter was run.

sources.observed: The project documents experimental DWG reading as off by default and no DWG writing absent separately promoted write claims and independent acceptance.
sources.limits: This is a downstream project policy statement, not a libdxfrw ABI/UI test or a general 3D support result.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: classify external observers by exact route, direction, version, and output projection
PAR-14: keep raw-carrier matching, geometry semantics, and native consumer qualification as separate evidence stages
RPP-4: finish MATERIAL map scalar controls before mapper transforms; do not infer DWG body semantics from DXF fields
RPP-5: include nested TABLESTYLE row true-color/CMC cases and preserve-or-refuse behavior

planChanges: Added a route/evidence table for LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, GDAL/OGR, FreeCAD, and LibreCAD 3.
Clarified that FreeCAD qualification cannot establish ACIS solid semantics through its documented standard importer route.
Limited GDAL use to exact projected primitive/topology observations or AC1027+ raw ASM carrier inspection; Binary DXF is not DWG support.
Refined RPP-4c/RPP-4d and RPP-5 with repeated-group, bounded-string, matrix, nested true-color, raw-net, and following-record controls.
Preserved focused fast validation, generated-from-scratch committed tests, no support promotion, and external-gate status.
limitations: Mutable project branches, release pages, and documentation may change; observations are timestamped and route/version scoped.
No peer artifact, application, kernel, or external drawing was executed or downloaded.
This review did not inspect new DWG wire layouts; the local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for such changes.
Native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification, independent ACIS/ACDS semantic evidence, and all six deferred J items remain unresolved.
